name: @calyx/shared-types
description: Proto files of the Calyx core API, their generated Go module, and the OpenAPI document of the backend.
author: CSMarckitus <88045486+CSMarckitus@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.proto:check:go: d=$(mktemp -d) && protoc --go_out="$d" --go_opt=module=github.com/csmarckitus/calyx/packages/shared-types/go --go-grpc_out="$d" --go-grpc_opt=module=github.com/csmarckitus/calyx/packages/shared-types/go --proto_path=./proto ./proto/calyx/core/v1/event.proto ./proto/calyx/core/v1/instance.proto ./proto/calyx/core/v1/message.proto && diff -r "$d/corev1" go/corev1; s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $s
